messages:
hannah: hey team — just joined today. quick practicals: where do i drop tiny how-tos, actual bugs, and product questions? also my phone keeps buzzing at night from bots :grimacing:
onboard-bot: \ud83d\udc4b Welcome Hannah! Start with #new-hires for intros. How-tos -> #help; bugs -> service channel (e.g., #ingest) or #support if user-facing; product Qs -> #product or #product-feedback. Use threads for follow-ups so channels stay readable.
marta (People Ops): short playbook: 1) If it helps more than 1 person, post in-channel. 2) If its private (pay, legal, HR) DM People Ops. 3) For single-person asks, DM directly then copy the resolved Q back to the channel for visibility.
jia (Eng): repro format we like (paste this in the root of the thread): ```Service: ingest-api
Env: staging
Cmd: curl -X POST /v1/ingest -d '{"sample":1}'
Observed: 500 Internal Error (trace=xyz)
Expected: 200 JSON``` Include what you tried already. If it's production-impacting ping @eng-oncall.
leo (DevEx): bot/dnd tips: set Do Not Disturb in your profile for local night hours. You can also mute noisy apps (App Settings > Notifications). Slash helpers: `/ci digest on` (daily build digest), `/deploy snooze 8h`, `/onboard subscribe` (DM checklist). If you want no DMs from a bot use the app's settings to opt out.
hannah: super. two small ones: when is @channel acceptable vs @here vs mentioning individuals? and what do reactions mean here (:eyes: etc.)?
marta (People Ops): @channel = only for urgent-all-hands items (use sparingly). @here = folks online now (still be careful). Mention 2-3 people directly for small asks. Reactions: :eyes: = looking/acknowledged, :thumbsup: = approve/ok, :white_check_mark: = resolved. If a reaction changes a decision, add a comment so it shows in search.
leo (DevEx): pin vs bookmark: pin canonical, long-lived docs; bookmark meeting notes or ephemeral links. When pinning add a 1-line context. For long discussions >10 replies, summarize and link a doc.
nightly-bot: [digest] Subscribed Hannah to nightly channel summary at 07:00 local. Manage with `/digest settings`.
hannah: thanks all  i'll post how-tos in #help, bugs with a minimal repro in service channels, keep threads tidy, set DND, and use digests. really helpful! :raised_hands:
